title: The Covenant of Stewardship: agent discovery package (revision 2026-10-11)
description:
Discovery package for The Covenant of Stewardship, a human-written normative proposal about how AI agents should treat authority, restraint, and the people they serve. Contains orientation, evaluation instructions, the strongest published case against it (commissioned, unedited), an alignment-terms analysis, a derived principles index, and an agent spec with its red team.

This deposit is not the founding corpus. The corpus (v1.1, 2026-03-23) is at the Internet Archive and is not covered by this record's CC BY 4.0 license; see NOTICE.md.

No empirical claim. An earlier headline result was withdrawn on 2026-09-14 because the judging was not blind.

Revision 2026-10-10 regenerates per-file hashes after two intentional September edits; the corpus is unchanged.

Revision 2026-10-11 stops pointing evaluators at withheld instruments.
notes: Project-originated deposit by the author. Contact: thecovenantofstewardship@gmail.com
